invariant.subject: uuid
invariant.source: 48-bit big-endian unsigned number of the Unix Epoch timestamp
invariant.relation: How UUIDv7 carries time inside an identifier

candidates: The story explains how UUIDv7 carries time within the identifier: its time-bearing component is a 48-bit, big-endian unsigned Unix Epoch timestamp. The main point for readers is that the timestamp is part of UUIDv7 itself.
- **Endpoint:** Bring the focus back to the central idea: UUIDv7 carries that timestamp within the identifier itself.
- **Context:** Introduce UUIDv7 as the identifier at the center of the story.
